checkpoint_finding.interpretation: Eligible for a sealed target-label evaluation after runtime and task-data gates pass. This does not support a claim that sealed loci or reference alleles were unseen.

known_incidents_and_biases: BPE segmentation can change between REF and ALT and can create a tokenization artifact mistaken for a biological variant effect.
The model is not reverse-complement equivariant; both orientations must be evaluated.
The checkpoint runs custom Hugging Face code, including a pinned Triton attention path.
A sequence-only likelihood delta has no direct cell-type context and no principled sign for eQTL or ieQTL effect direction.
remaining_blockers: Register an exposed, nonsealed signed eQTL or ieQTL development source before fitting the common supervised heads.
Resolve the exact human assembly and retained sequence inventory in the 135-species corpus, or keep locus exposure at encoder_seen or unknown.
Acquire the checkpoint only after campaign approval, verify SHA-256, and convert the state dict to safetensors in a no-network restricted process.
Vendor and hash all custom Hugging Face source, then validate the Python 3.8, Torch 1.13.1, Transformers 4.29.2, Triton, and PEFT stack on L40S.
Fixture-test base-coordinate token mapping, REF/ALT segmentation changes, reverse-complement alignment, long-window truncation, and deterministic outputs.
